steward_ingra.name: Ingra, Steward of Saltfell
lines_first: Late for the feast, traveller? The fires are high and the mead is cold, the way it should be.
This is Saltfell Steading. Tonight is the last long evening of summer — the shearing starts at first light.
If you sit by the hearthstone, mind it: they say it remembers. Sit long enough and it will show you what it remembers now.
lines_repeat: Eat something. Winter is a long way off yet.
The headman is in the long hall, counting the stores again.

services.label: Trade for a Deep Gourd — 300 warmth
Learn the Mending Song — 200 warmth
services.line_done: Hum it low. It works better when nobody is listening.

brede.name: Brede
lines_first: Mind the oars. No, the other way. Thank you.
Brede. I'd shake your hand but I've had it in fish guts all afternoon.
Off to Kettle Fjord at first light. They've a healer there, a good one. There's a few coughing up at the house. Nothing much. Children, mostly.
Gunna says I'm not to go. Gunna says a lot of things. She's mending the big net, so she's not speaking to anyone anyway.
Lost my float off the herring net this morning. Cork, my knot burned on it. If the tide brings it in, I'd thank you for it. She'll notice it's gone and I'll never hear the end of it.
lines_repeat: Tide's right at first light. I'll be back before she's finished being cross.
Ever been to Kettle Fjord? They boil the fish in kettles the size of this boat. You can smell it a day out.
Don't tell Gunna I said she was cross.

aud.name: Aud, barrow-keeper's widow
lines_first: Mind the road. They like you on the road.
That one's the Holms'. That one's the miller's people. That one's empty, whatever anyone tells you.
My husband kept these forty years. I know every mound on the Lowe. I'm wrong about two of them and I'll thank you not to say which.
lines_repeat: Turf goes back the same day. That's the whole of it.
Arne cut every sod on this hill. You can tell his by the edge.

hesk.name: Hesk, travelling smith
lines_first: Don't stand there, you're in my draught.
Bog-iron. You rake it out of the black water and it comes up looking like dung. Give it a day in here and it's a hinge.
If you find any, bring it. I'll make it into something you won't be ashamed of.
lines_repeat: Wind's wrong again. It's always wrong on the Lowe.
Bring me iron. I'll do the rest.
